title: Cog shell gate = slow diffusion replicates on fresh seed 6: with the outside supply cut, the ungated cog dies at t=905 while the shell-gated (beta=betaW=8) and the uniformly slow (D=DW=0.0007) cogs are both intact at t=1300
summary: Ran the finding's world.py and runsave.py unchanged on fresh seed 6: pre-run from noise to t=600, then (mkann.py, written here to rebuild the finding's annulus checkpoint) the most isolated cog (nearest other core 57 px) with food removed every step in the annulus 12<r<20 around it, 700 t per arm. Ungated: food inside r<6 falls from 1.45 to 0.035 within 100 t and the cog collapses below 10% of its matter at t=905 (finding: 910-925). Gated (beta=betaW=8): cog 0.996-1.0 to t=1300, interior food rising 1.48 -> 1.68. Uniformly low D (D=DW=0.0007): cog 0.999-1.0 to t=1300, food 1.44. Gated fed twin: 1.0. Labkit pack of the world on seed 6 (t=1000) for the re-run requirement.

observations.finding: annulus_seed6.json: ungated cog <10% at t=905 (food inside 0.009); gated 0.999 and uniformly-low-D 1.001 at t=1300 (food 1.70 and 1.44); gated fed twin 1.001

seeds_run.result: pass: ungated dies at t=905; gated and uniformly slow both survive to t=1300

controls_run.finding: ungated6, gated6, lowD6, gatedfed6 from the same t=600 state with the same annulus cut (annulus_seed6.json)

verdicts.limitation: One fresh seed and one cog. The annulus checkpoint was rebuilt with my mkann.py (same cog choice as the claim's mkcut.py, annulus 12<r<20 as in the README), not the finding's own file. I did not repeat the food-only gate or the waste-contrast measurement.
